snippet.title: NORMENHILL: Chapter 1 "Your New Look" 2025 Trailer
snippet.description:
Normenhill is an Action-Adventure videogame with RPG elements about adventures in the World of Darkness, friendship and problem solving without violence (Or not quite?) for PC inspired by Undertale, Deltarune, Chrono Trigger, Shovel Knight, Hollow Knight and Rayman.
It's up to you to decide what to do here in any case, SEE YOU IN THE DARKNESS!

You can follow and play it here:

Gamejolt: https://gamejolt.com/games/normenhill/931594
Itch.io: https://thegoetiasquirrel.itch.io/normenhill
IndieDB: https://www.indiedb.com/games/normenhill-chapter-1-your-new-look

Also visit the website and follow other socials for more content related to the game:

Website: https://normenhill.neocities.org/
Tiktok: https://www.tiktok.com/@thegoetiasquirrel?_t=8r1Cxscq3Lb&_r=1
Bluesky: https://bsky.app/profile/thegoetiasquirrel.bsky.social
Telegram: https://t.me/thegoetiasquirrel_ru

Music by me and _RomaMegaG_
